children.prompt: State why these two triangles are similar.

answer.worked: The marked angles give $\angle A=\angle F=\beta$ and $\angle C=\angle E=\alpha$. The remaining angles at B and D are equal by the triangle angle sum, so $\triangle ABC\sim\triangle FDE$ by AAA.
Corresponding sides give $\frac{AC}{FE}=\frac{AB}{FD}$, so $\frac{x}{5}=\frac{7}{10}$. Hence $x=3.5\text{ cm}$.
